changelog.body:
- Fixed core engine installation detection and in-app download launcher
- Updated core installer bottom sheet with smooth Lottie animation lifecycle

- Added Native In-App Downloads with instant LSPosed hook integration for supported apps (YouTube & YouTube Music)
- Directly intercept the official download button inside target apps to open KGPT Downloader seamlessly
- Instant dynamic scope authorization via modern LSPosed service
- Added Smart Folders: Group by Source App and Organize by Channel / Creator with audio/video separation
- Redesigned Download Core Engine card with modern centered layout, dynamic smooth Lottie animation lifecycle, and transforming progress status button
- Converted Direct Link Download into an elegant collapsible accordion
- Simplified Floating Downloader Guide bottom sheet with clean concise text layout
- Added Public Media & No DRM Notice card
- Updated Backup & Restore screen icons with sleek new vector drawables
- Fixed blank white screen issues when clicking search result hyperlinks and navigating pages within the in-app browser

- Added support for Custom AI Providers and Local LLM Models (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, DeepInfra, Together AI)
- Added new built-in AI provider: Grok (xAI) with latest models (grok-2, grok-2-mini, grok-beta, grok-vision-beta)
- Added new built-in AI provider: DeepSeek with reasoning & smart models (deepseek-chat, deepseek-reasoner, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-coder, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1)
- Added new built-in AI provider: Kimi (Moonshot AI) with latest models (kimi-k3, kimi-k2.6, kimi-k2.7-code, kimi-k2.5, moonshot-v1)
- Redesigned and modernized the Add Custom Provider bottom sheet with fluid transitions and in-place connection testing
- Enhanced the API Keys management screen with smooth Lottie animations, custom brand logos, and seamless eye toggle visibility

- Fixed YouTube media download failing with HTTP 403 Forbidden / SABR streaming restrictions
- Added automatic background yt-dlp core update & smart retry mechanism
- Configured Android player client extraction fallback for reliable high-speed video/audio downloads
- Suppressed outdated engine warning messages in UI

• Added support for GLM models provided by ZhipuAI.
• Fixed app crash when changing language and attempting to enter AI Invocation section.
• Fixed missing space issue when using text formatting commands.
• Fixed the issue where text disappears when using an unregistered trigger or receiving no response from AI.
• Improved design of the alert appearance in the in-app changelog.

- Migrated from LSPosed API 82 to modern API 102
- Major performance optimizations and reduced battery consumption
- Fixed various freeze, hang, and ANR scenarios
- Added new keyboard trigger: Media Downloader Trigger
- Added new Text Selection action: Media Downloader
- Added new Lab feature: KGPT Media Downloader
- Added live YouTube and video search feature
- Added Video & Audio downloading with custom formats, quality, and trimming
- Added Universal Standalone Command generator to download on any device
- Added support for new added models

- Added paid/free API key classification system.
- Added 'Get Key' button for easier access.
- Improved secondary key card design consistency.
- Updated README and documentation.

• Winter Mode: Added a verified interactive snowfall effect
• Interactive Snowfall: Snow accumulates on cards and reacts to touch
• UI Improvements: Reorganized Settings page for better accessibility
• Animations: Updated version card animation in Update Settings page
• Enjoy :)

readme:
KGPT

AI in your keyboard. Everywhere. Anytime.

--- ## Introduction A special thanks to **Mino260806** for establishing the original idea and foundation upon which this project was developed. Without their initial work, this repository would not exist today. **KGPT** is a powerful tool designed to integrate your favorite AI models directly into your keyboard, allowing you to use them seamlessly across various tasks and activities on your device. > [!IMPORTANT] > **This is NOT just a standard update of the original project.** > This is a complete **structural rebuild and redesign from scratch**. The code has been rewritten with an entirely different infrastructure, changing the core logic and introducing features that never existed before. --- ## Screenshots
Amoled Mode

Dark Mode

Light Mode

--- ## Features This rebuild includes a vast array of new capabilities (too many to list everything, but here are the highlights): - **Superior Usability**: A fully developed application with a modern, advanced user interface using the latest **MD3 Expressive** design standards. - **Elegant & Modern Design**: Smart design concepts that make using the app a visually and practically enjoyable experience. - **Internal Update System**: Automatically keeps you informed and updated with the latest versions directly within the app. - **Detailed Changelog**: Built-in system to display detailed changelogs for every update. - **Redesigned Web Search**: Support for over 10 search engines (including the absolute best) and AI-powered search tools like **Perplexity AI**. - **App Trigger**: Instantly switch between apps using a custom trigger command you define. - **Unrestricted Customization**: "Open limits" philosophy allowing you to customize triggers exactly how you want without restrictions. - **Advanced Command System**: Execute complex operations that would usually require extensive typing with a simple, single command while typing. - **Evolution of Floating Windows**: Redesigned legacy floating windows (location, appearance, interaction) to help users from the original version adapt to the new experience. - **Latest AI Model Support**: Updated support for all AI types, including the newest models like **Gemini 1.5/2.0**. - **AI Text Actions**: Select any text to access default options (Refresh, Improve, Translate, Summarize, Explain, Formal, Casual, etc.) and add your own advanced custom actions. - **Full Theme Support**: Complete support for **Amoled**, **Dark**, and **Light** modes, featuring a special winter animation. - **Material You Customization**: Extract colors directly from your wallpaper (on supported Android versions) or set a **custom seed color**. - **Blur Effects**: Adjustable blur transparency, color, and behavior (derived from background or custom seed). - **Update Settings**: Control download paths and perform manual update checks. - **Full Backup & Restore**: Backup literally everything—settings, keys, themes, commands, triggers—and choose exactly what to restore. - **Guidance Cards**: In-app tips to help you understand and use various features. - *And much, much more...* ---

Built with ❤️ for the Android community
